title: Functional Service Provider and CRO Technology Comparison
summary: Comparison of major CROs and their FSP technology approaches, EDC environments, and regulatory information management systems.

findings.fsp_model_overview: FSP models provide sponsors with dedicated functional resources using either the sponsor's or CRO's technology. Technology flexibility is a key competitive differentiator.
findings.technology_patterns: CROs take different approaches: proprietary stack as part of FSP, technology-agnostic deployment into client systems, or hybrid. Most competitive offerings support both.
findings.data_management: FSP clinical data management spans multiple EDC environments. Leading CROs support 5+ EDC platforms, deploying data managers into any client environment.
findings.automation_investment: CROs investing in ML for data review, automated protocol deviation detection, and NLP for medical coding to improve FSP margins and create lock-in.
findings.crm_implications: CRO technology choices influence CRM requirements. Sponsor CRM may need integration for visit data, site communication logs, and issue tracking.

source: CRO and FSP technology comparison of clinical technology platform approaches
